portInfo.description: Marseille handles large ships primarily at Marseille Provence Cruise Terminal (MPCT / Môle Léon Gourret), several kilometres from the Vieux-Port, while smaller vessels may use La Joliette closer to the waterfront. A port shuttle is the usual first link from MPCT toward Joliette shopping/metro connections.
portInfo.location: Southern France, Bouches-du-Rhône, on the Mediterranean
portInfo.population: City roughly 870,000; metro area over 1.5 million

facts.established: Ancient Greek founding (Massalia); modern cruise terminals within Grand Port Maritime de Marseille-Fos
facts.significance: France’s leading Mediterranean cruise port and major Provençal gateway
notableFeatures: La Joliette / J4 berths for smaller ships
Notre-Dame de la Garde basilica skyline
culturalHighlights: Day trips to Aix-en-Provence or Calanques (time permitting)

size.portCapacity: Large-ship MPCT complex plus nearer-in Joliette berths for smaller vessels
size.annualVisitors: Among France’s higher-volume Mediterranean cruise ports (confirm current-year GPMM figures)
size.citySize: Marseille ≈ 0.87 million residents within city limits

climate.rainySeason: Autumn can bring heavier rain; Mistral wind can feel strong
climate.humidity: Dry heat is common in summer
climate.description: Summer is peak cruise season but punishing for the uphill walk to Notre-Dame de la Garde. Shoulder months are often kinder for long walks from Joliette.

politics.stability: Ordinary urban/tourist awareness applies; check local notices if demonstrations or large events affect transfer routes.
politics.visaRequirements: France follows Schengen / European short-stay frameworks for many travelers, but visa and passport rules depend on nationality and can change. Confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID only where your cruise line and destination authorities explicitly accept it). Shore excursions do not change document rules—keep required ID with you ashore.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Confirm whether you are at MPCT (large ships) or Joliette. MPCT sits in a secured port zone—do not plan to walk through industrial areas.
gettingThere.distanceToCity: MPCT is about 8 km from the Vieux-Port by road (commonly cited ~7–10 km depending on routing); Joliette berths are much closer (~1–2 km)
gettingThere.walkingTime: Joliette to Vieux-Port often 20–30 minutes. MPCT walking is not practical/permitted through the port—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.taxiInfo: Direct taxis from MPCT to Vieux-Port are the fastest door-to-door option when queues are long
gettingThere.publicTransport: Free port shuttle (cruise days): from the ship, follow the green line 5–12 min to the stop near Gate 4. In town, the stop is at 9 Quai du Lazaret, between Les Terrasses du Port and the maritime station. RTM 35T: links the Terminal Croisières stop with Place de la Joliette; the timetable is adapted to ship arrivals. From the stop it can be 600 m to 2.5 km to the boarding platform. Joliette → Vieux-
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: MPCT is about 8 km from the Vieux-Port by road (commonly cited ~7–10 km depending on routing); Joliette berths are much closer (~1–2 km)

thingsToDo.intro: Large ships use MPCT far from the Vieux-Port; smaller ships may berth nearer Joliette. Your terminal choice decides whether the day feels walkable.
topThings: Le Panier, the old quarter above the port. 60 min.
Notre-Dame de la Garde, the hilltop basilica. 75 min including the climb or bus.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not walk through the industrial port from MPCT. Use the port/city shuttle or a taxi toward Joliette / Vieux-Port.
